settings.bookingLinkHint: The booking link is only useful if the clinic can be reached from the internet.

templates.appointment_reminder: Hello {firstName}, this is a reminder of your appointment at {clinic} on {date} at {time} with {provider}. Please reply to this message to confirm. If you cannot come, call us on {clinicPhone}.
templates.recall: Hello {firstName}, your last visit to {clinic} was more than {months} months ago. Regular check-ups prevent many dental problems. Reply to this message or call {clinicPhone} to book an appointment.
templates.treatment_followup: Hello {firstName}, your treatment at {clinic} is not finished yet. To book your next session, reply to this message or call {clinicPhone}.
templates.estimate_followup: Hello {firstName}, have you had a chance to review the estimate from {clinic}? We are happy to answer your questions on {clinicPhone}.
templates.no_show: Hello {firstName}, we missed you at your appointment on {date} at {clinic}. Would you like to book a new one? Reply to this message or call {clinicPhone}.
templates.after_visit: Hello {firstName}, thank you for your visit to {clinic}. {careInstructions} If you have any pain or questions, call us on {clinicPhone}.
templates.referral_thanks: Hello {firstName}, thank you for recommending our clinic to people close to you: your trust means a lot to us. See you soon, the {clinic} team.
templates.installment_due: Hello {firstName}, a quick reminder: an installment of {amount} for your treatment at {clinic} is due on {date}. For any question, call us on {clinicPhone}. Thank you!

followUps.reviewSentence: If you were happy with your visit, a review would help us a lot: {reviewLink}

publicPage.title: Clinic public page

paymentPlans.title: Payment schedule
paymentPlans.description: Split the accepted estimate into installments. A payment received on an installment stays a patient deposit, used later for their invoices.

paymentPlans.shareHint: Print the estimate (or save it as PDF) to give it to the patient. The WhatsApp button sends the link to their patient area, where the estimate and schedule are visible if they have access.

settings.title: Clinic computer
settings.subtitle: Work without internet: a clinic computer holds the data and syncs with the online copy.
settings.how1: One clinic computer (on during opening hours) holds the data. Every device on the clinic Wi-Fi uses it, even without internet.
settings.how2: When internet works, it syncs with the online copy: online booking, the clinic page, the patient portal and viewing from your phone.
settings.how3: Once the computer is paired, the online copy is view-only for the team: changes are made at the clinic.
settings.label: Computer name

settings.unpairHint: The online copy is in charge again. Changes made at the clinic and not yet sent will be lost.
settings.unpaired: The clinic computer was unpaired. The online copy is in charge again.
